name: 🦃 Turkey & Black Bean Cottage Cheese Bake
what: A cheesy layered taco bake: turkey and beans, a creamy middle, tortillas between.

core.name: Tortillas
core.out: crushed tortilla chips between the layers

extras: salsa, taco seasoning, frozen corn, onion, sour cream

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 375°F, grease a 9×13.
Brown the turkey (and onion). Stir in taco seasoning, a splash of water, beans, corn and some salsa.
Mix the cottage cheese with salsa and a cup of the cheese.
Layer: tortillas, half the meat, the cottage cheese mix, tortillas, the rest of the meat, cheese on top.
Bake covered 20 min, uncovered 10. Rest 5 minutes before cutting.

key: Mix salsa and cheese into the cottage cheese. Plain, it tastes flat; mixed, nobody notices it.
done: Bubbling at the edges and the cheese on top is melted and spotty.
plan_b: Skip the baking: serve the meat and beans as taco bowls or in tortillas.
